name: Chrome Automation
description: Automate Google Chrome navigation, web search, tab & window management, and page extraction.
author: SORA Core

chromeExecutablePath.description: Custom path to chrome.exe (leave blank for automatic Windows detection)

defaultSearchEngine.description: Search engine URL prefix for search queries

tools.name: chrome_search_and_navigate
tools.description: Search the web or navigate to a target URL in Google Chrome.

url.description: The URL to navigate to, or search query (e.g. 'https://github.com' or 'AI research')

newTab.description: Whether to open in a new tab

tools.name: chrome_manage_tabs
tools.description: Manage Chrome tabs: open a new tab or list navigation actions. Use this ONLY to open a blank new tab. If the user wants to search for something or navigate to a URL, use chrome_search_and_navigate instead.

action.description: Tab action to perform ('open' opens a new blank tab, 'close', 'list')

url.description: URL to open when action is 'open'. Omit or leave blank to open the browser's default new-tab page. Do NOT pass 'about:blank' here – simply omit the url field for a blank new tab.

tools.name: chrome_manage_windows
tools.description: Open a new Chrome window or private Incognito window.

incognito.description: Open in Incognito / private browsing mode

url.description: Initial URL to open in the new window

tools.name: chrome_interact_page
tools.description: Extract text, headlines, and readable content from a web page.

url.description: The URL of the webpage to fetch and inspect

maxLength.description: Maximum number of extracted characters to return (default: 4000)
